source: Pew Research Center. 2012. "2011 National Survey of Mormons."
method: Population is all respondents (self-identified Mormons by the survey's own design), broken out by self-reported activity level in the Church (q406). q409f asks whether the respondent believes in yoga, not just as exercise, but as a spiritual practice; its own don't know/refused is excluded from each row's denominator. Weighted by the dataset's own `weight` variable.
